note: Revolution-format motion plan for EP35 'FOLLOWING THE RULE.' (Carole Hinders / civil forfeiture / structuring). Exact text, dates, amounts, citations, counters and diagrams are code-rendered in Remotion (never baked into AI stills). Perceptual motion budget (depth 45% / moving FigureBeats 27 / hero surfaces 8 / ~2.32s cut cadence / ForcefulCut transitions) per EP35_hinders_DESIGN.v001 sec3. fps=60, 1920x1080. key_graphics map to CaseFilm FigureBeats via build_case_film_assets.key_graphic_to_figure; scene_id S0NN anchors to narration span SPN-00NN.

global.citation_policy: CitationLowerThird / QuoteCard for case, statute, statistic and headline graphics tied to claim_id.
global.synthetic_label: symbolic reconstruction on all AI reenactment/location sequences (no real-person likeness).

motion_budget.cut_cadence_note: Design target 1225s / 528 cuts = 2.32s average. Builder derives the real cut grid from the actual master narration length; this budget pins the depth share and the figure map.

depth.definition: depth-treated cut = DepthImageV (dpt-large depth map) applied to a single-image cut. Figure layer parallax (L3 near/mid/far) is a separate mechanism and is NOT counted here.

reusable_components: DepthImageV (base): per-image dpt-large depth-map parallax on >=45% of single-image cuts; depth maps pre-generated by tools/depth/gen_depth.py.
ForcefulCut (base): mode push|slide|zoompunch|whip — every inter-cut transition; NO WipeTransition/crossfade default.
KineticType / KineticCaptions (base): mask-cut-up kinetic captions with motion blur, translateY reveal.
CitationLowerThird / OpenCaption (base): case citations, statute numbers and force-aligned captions.
NumberTicker (motionkit): count-up amounts and statistics (38 years, $32,820.56, 301 deposits, 91%, $17.1M).
ProbableCauseMeter (motionkit): threshold / burden meters (stall vs cross).
CaseTimeline (motionkit): 1970 BSA -> 1986 structuring -> 2014 front page -> 2019 reform timeline.
CitationLowerThird (motionkit): case caption 'United States v. $32,820.56', 8th Cir. fee ruling.
PinDropMap (motionkit): Iowa vs North Carolina parallel (Hinders / McLellan).
ActTitle (motionkit): section / reframe title cards ('STRUCTURING', 'STILL ON THE BOOKS', 'THAT IS NEXT').

recompute_note: Per-section still_cuts/depth_cuts added so preflight_render_gate.py can recompute depth share from cut_plan. Sums match cut_plan_totals (still_cuts 324, depth_cuts 239 -> 73.8% of still cuts depth-treated; 45.3% of all cuts). Actual render (hinders_film.json) delivers 122 depth of 271 img cuts = 45% (film_crosscheck), both >= 40% floor.
